paras: The Zaero Designs EVO-1 Full Kit for Volkswagen Golf MK8 GTI 2021+ is the ultimate upgrade for your car. Like all Zaero Design products, this full body kit is designed to add a touch of aggression whilst integrating flawlessly with the car’s natural aesthetic. This product is also engineered to fit like OEM for a headache-free install.
This part is made from a high-grade, UV Resistant gloss black ABS Plastic. It is designed and manufactured in Germany.
